title: Memory
subsystem_derivation: 03 §4.2 (memory — governing space). LAW = allocation policy + budgets; DECISIONS = mapping created / region granted / page evicted / budget amended; INPUTS = faults as arrival events; CACHE = page tables and free-lists; STREAM = raw accesses.

rows.conformance_note: Region grant/release against the caller's budget — recorded. Returns new break / old break exactly; ENOMEM on budget exhaustion identical.
rows.probe_absent_reason: the memory group is inactive until EP-31 (design/36 §6). A row's probe steps are row DATA in this same file; they are authored when the group activates, so activation is a data change in this tree and never a harness-code change.
